title: New mechanics preview
objectives: Try the five newly-supported exercise types: find-check, find-checkmate, order-steps, guided-sequence, and mini-game

steps.text: This is a preview lesson exercising the five step types just added to the renderer: find-check, find-checkmate, order-steps, guided-sequence, and mini-game. It isn't part of the curated curriculum — it's a working demo of each mechanic.

steps.prompt: Click a square your queen could move to that would put the black king in check.

feedback.default: None of those deliver check. Look at every square the queen can reach in one move — which ones land on the same rank, file, or diagonal as the black king?

steps.prompt: Click the square your rook could move to that would deliver checkmate.

feedback.default: Not mate. The black king is trapped behind its own pawns — which rook move controls the entire back rank with no escape square?

steps.prompt: Play the opening moves: advance your e-pawn, develop your knight, then develop your bishop.

steps.objective: Checkmate the lone black king with your queen and king.

steps.summary: That covers all thirteen exercise-step types the schema supports. Real lesson content for these mechanics — a proper 'Check and Checkmate' unit, an opening-principles unit, an endgame-practice unit — is still to be authored.
